extracted.name: Ham and Brie Sandwich
extracted.description: Black forest ham, brie, Dijon mustard, and apricot preserves are grilled on Italian bread to make these delightfully simple sandwiches that go beyond a typical grilled cheese.
instruction_lines: To assemble the sandwiches: Layer ham, Brie cheese, apricot preserves, and mustard in equal amounts on two pieces of bread, topping with the remaining two slices of bread. Brush top of each sandwich with olive oil.

Heat a grill pan over medium heat. Once the pan is hot, place sandwiches, oiled-side down, in the pan. Brush top of each sandwich with oil. Cook each side until bread is golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes per side.
